label: Wasabi backup destination
summary: Prepare an optional bucket-scoped backup destination with explicit storage and retention boundaries.
core_boundary: Core retains recovery policy and local continuity; provider-specific retention or commercial storage conditions are not invented here. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Qualify region, bucket, key prefix and credential restrictions for the chosen provider API.
Observe integrity and retention capabilities instead of treating a successful upload as an immutable backup.
Exercise failed upload, unavailable credentials, forbidden deletion and a verified clean-target restore.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
